name: CHORD Tables: the stock CHORD machine plays wavetables from the +Drive, one table per pattern, PATTERN + SWEEP picks it
description: An extension of the stock CHORD machine (notes/66): since 0.3 (notes/66 §27 to §31) the pattern chooses one table for every CHORD track. PATTERN + SWEEP on a CHORD track steps the shown pattern's value, 0 to 127, two steps a table: 0 the stock table, 1 to 63 the files of /Wavetables on the +Drive whose names start with 01 to 63 and then no digit (07, 07 Glass Pad; since 0.4: the folder listed with the OS's own calls, notes/66 §36; mono sample files of k x 256 samples, k single-cycle frames, k = 1 to 32, the OS's sine put in front of a file whose first frame is not one), loaded on the screen's tick; the value is kept in the pattern header's bytes 36 and 37. The whole table takes the stock table's place in SRAM, so SWEEP and an LFO on it cost what they cost on the stock OS: a table change reads the new frames in SDRAM from the next block and moves them into SRAM over a few blocks, every voice's pointers moved with them. A pattern at 0, every pattern saved before, and every other track play as on the stock OS.

uses.why: an extension of CHORD, machine 5: no machine of its own, no descriptor of its own, nothing registered
CHORD's update gets its two frames through this one call (notes/66 §1.1): the stock function at the stock table, the same work on the pattern's table otherwise

the screen's redraw, about 30 Hz, UI task: the move on the first tick, then the loader: /Wavetables listed 16 entries a tick, then one file a tick that needs the drive; with SAMPLE, through the tick dispatcher

PATTERN + SWEEP on a CHORD track gives descriptor 10, display only, whose popup shows the pattern's table (notes/66 §28.2); in front of the filter slot's or the shortcut layer's lookup, else the stock one (notes/66 §30.2)
the encoder handler's question for TRACK, before any edit: on descriptor 10 the step of the pattern's value; in front of the filter slot's and the effect slots' entries
PATTERN released without opening the selection's window ends the selection's wait (notes/68 §23): the effect slots' entry when the build has them, the same work
the pattern header's loader copies only the OS's fields: bytes 36 and 37 kept when their check holds (notes/68 §13.2), after the effect slots' bytes
a new pattern's header: bytes 36 and 37 at the stock table, after the effect slots' bytes
one file as read, 71 table buffers (63 slots, 8 spare), the stock frames' copy, the listing's 63 names and its folder entry, 2.4 MB (notes/66 §2.2, §31, §36)
22 of the stock table's 30 frames in SRAM, read by CHORD alone (notes/27 §3.3): the pattern's table takes their place, the stock frames copied into the RAM claim (notes/66 §27.3)
the other 8 frames of the stock table in SRAM, the same (notes/66 §27.3)
